line: One continuous move from a liver slide to a single nucleus; two circles, counted pixel by pixel, differ 2.4 times in blue.
line_cn: 一镜从肝组织玻片推到单个细胞核，两个圆逐像素数出 2.4 倍的蓝。

camera.serves: an opening; from the slide to the cell

camera.expresses: a second sample of the same thing

camera.move: Pull back to frame two marks

camera.serves: a landing; a reveal inside one frame

camera.move: The climb (reverse dive, scale bar jumping back)
camera.serves: an ending; a return to the eye's scale

transitions: Transitions are scale changes, trucks and focus, never cuts or crossfades between samples.
labels: Roles: a light condensed grotesk for readings and the scale bar (40–72 px, e.g. Barlow Condensed); a monospace for instruments and pixel counts (20 px, e.g. IBM Plex Mono); a sans in the film's language for labels (20–34 px, e.g. Noto Sans SC); a serif only for the title. OFL, self-hosted, CJK subset.

Instruments live in one frosted panel in a corner: scale bar with its value, field of view, magnification with a small nosepiece glyph that turns a quarter on every change. The source credit in a small panel in the opposite corner.

Readings sit in a frosted panel beside what they measure, joined by a leader: a small label above ("collagen share of tissue area"), the number large in the accent, the method or the raw counts below.

Subtitles: a frosted strip at the bottom; if the film is bilingual, one line per language with the film's language on top, never wrapped. Measure each line with the real font and split long lines into two cues.
motion: The camera is a similarity transform (zoom, roll, position) interpolated as a log spiral between keys (M^u about the fixed point of the two frames), so every push is a true dive towards one point and the roll is part of it. Ease the moves, creep 2–5 % during holds; never a frozen frame longer than a second.
Magnification changes happen where the plates actually change, each with a breath of focus, a turret click and the new magnification said once, large.
Marks arrive by being made: a dimension line grows from its centre, a circle is drawn as an arc, a scan front counts pixels while the reading rolls, the reading lands with a small spring.
Never moves: the specimen under its marks, the instrument positions.

native_moves.name: The dive
native_moves.does: From the slide in the hand to a cell in one camera, the turret clicking at each real change of level.
native_moves.fits: a biopsy to its cells; a coated surface to its crystals; a hair or skin section to its layers.

native_moves.name: Counting the colour
native_moves.does: Draw a circle, let a scan front cross it, light up every counted pixel and roll the share up to its landing value; show the raw counts underneath.
native_moves.fits: collagen in tissue; porosity in a ceramic; coverage of a coating; pigment in a sample.

native_moves.name: Two circles, one verdict
native_moves.does: Measure one place, truck to another at the same scale, then frame both and say what differs.
native_moves.fits: treated against untreated; edge against centre; before against after.

native_moves.name: The focal sweep and the ring
native_moves.does: Land, sweep the focal plane across the frame, ring one structure and give its size.
native_moves.fits: a nucleus; a grain; a fibre's diameter.

native_moves.name: The climb back
native_moves.does: Pull out to the eye's scale with the scale bar jumping backwards; a title card written on the glass.

score.note: hard-mallet vibraphone in 8ths and 16ths, water glasses for the motif
